_comment: Story 15 (WIS-11). Deliberate exceptions to the no-hard-coded-strings rule. Every entry needs a reason. `literals` are exact JSX text / attribute values that never need translating; `patterns` are regexes for the same.
_rootsNote: Directories the check ENFORCES today. Story 16 (WIS-17) closed this list — every feature folder's literals have been migrated into its i18n namespace, matching the pattern established in auth and sla-rules.

literals.reason: Keyboard shortcut badge — must not mirror or translate (brief.md, Story 02).
Product name — rendered from the `brand` key where localized; the bare token is exempt.
ISO language pill in the header switcher — shows the language code, not prose.
ISO language pill in the header switcher — shows the language code, not prose.
Language toggle glyph on the login screen (Arabic letter ain).
Story 19 (WIS-18), Decision 6: the AI badge stays Latin in Arabic — the RTL artboard renders it untranslated, and 'ذكاء اصطناعي' triples the two-character pill's width.

patterns.reason: Pure numbers / punctuation / ISO-like tokens carry no translatable prose.
CSS custom-property reference in an inline style value — a style token, not user-facing text.
Story 16 (WIS-17): dotted i18n key reference in a fallback-label / key map (e.g. `priority.low`) — resolved through t(), not user-facing prose.
